newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly up, low sulphur fuel slips.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly up, low sulphur fuel slips.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly firmer on Monday, traders said.
Gasoline was a dollar or two firmer, with barges trading between $219 and $220 fob ARA.
Slow-trading naphtha was marginally firmer on the back of swaps, talked up to $1 higher.
Gas oil rose around $1 in line with futures but heating oil demand and volume were light due to ice-blocked Dutch canals.
Low sulphur fuel oil was a three dollars weaker after a distressed cargo traded very low late on Friday.
